class.name: JRPGCharacterMotion
class.brief_description: One character's movement of its own, one simulation step at a time.

method.name: force_route
method.description: Set Movement Route: [param route] runs from its start instead of the page's movement until it ends; a route given while another runs replaces it.

method.name: get_forced_route
method.description: Returns the route forced on the character, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: is_direction_fixed
method.description: Returns whether the facing stays through moves and turns.

method.name: is_route_forced
method.description: Returns whether a forced route is running.

method.name: set_page_movement
method.description: Sets the movement of the active page: [param type] ([enum JRPGEventPage.MovementType]), [param speed], [param frequency], its custom [param route], [param direction_fix] and [param through]. With [param restart] the page's route and pause start afresh (a new page); otherwise the saved position goes on (a loaded game).

method.name: setup
method.description: Sets the character the motion moves: its [param mover] and its saved [param state].

method.name: update_step
method.description: Runs one simulation step: [param blocked] lists the cells other characters take ([Vector2i]s), [param player_cell] is the player's cell, [param game_state] the state route switches change, and [param random] the stream random choices come from.

constants.constant: The lowest frequency: the longest pause.
The most steps added at random to a pause.
Route commands that take no time run together, at most this many in a step.
Cells an approach looks through for a way to the player.
A step was taken, or skipped.
A move was blocked: it is tried again at the next step.
The route has no more commands.
